answer.rationale: Add a qualified second source through a guarded test rather than renewing the incumbent at unchanged pricing or abruptly moving all volume. Prior dual sourcing reduced shortage exposure, while the low-cost vendor demonstrated rapid onboarding and accurate invoicing. The 94% line loading and lack of buffer make a full switch too risky; the test preserves continuity while creating leverage toward the mandated cost reduction. Verify both records before committing.
